survivors.claim: The overlap leg selects siblings purely by `stage:"plan"` row age and never by spec status, so on this host every lock lists every spec locked in the last 7 days including ones already `done` — 25 hits, exit 1, and a remedy (fold / `depends_on`) that cannot be followed for a closed spec. The code matches D3 verbatim (D3 names no status filter), so this is a plan-level gap surfaced by the cold walk for the planner journey ('fold into it or declare depends_on before two builds race the same lines' — a done spec's build cannot race), not a code-vs-spec contradiction.
survivors.impact: Every future plan lock in this repository exits red with a page of overlap hits against finished work and tells the planner to fold into or depend on specs that are already closed.
survivors.evidence: Executed `node spec/scripts/collision-closure.js --spec specs/20261103/13-a-change-is-sized-by-its-files.md --root .` → `overlap leg:` lists 25 siblings (e.g. `specs/20261029/01-model-placement-refresh.md: 4 shared — README.md, spec/commands/fix.md, …`, `specs/20261101/07-…: 6 shared — …`, all `status: done` per the ledger/queue) followed by `remedy: fold this draft into the overlapping sibling, or add the sibling to \`depends_on\`…`, exit=1. Code: `for (const row of readLedgerRows(root)) { if (row.stage !== 'plan' || typeof row.spec !== 'string' || row.spec === specRel) continue; if (!(Date.parse(row.ts) >= cutoff)) continue; siblings.add(row.spec) }` — no status read. Spec Users row 2: 'When my draft shares three files with a spec locked three days ago, I want the lock to tell me which spec and which files, so I can fold into it or declare depends_on before two builds race the same lines.'
